sentences.en: TUTOR: First of all I'd just like to say, Cristina and Ibrahim, that I really enjoyed watching your video about student life last week, and I could see that the rest of the group did too.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 首先，我想对克里斯蒂娜和易卜拉欣说，上周我非常欣赏你们制作的关于学生生活的视频，我也看得出小组其他成员同样很喜欢。

sentences.en: You did really well, and I hope that you got a lot out of it.
sentences.zh: 你们表现得非常出色，希望你们也从中收获良多。

sentences.en: I'd like to use this tutorial as a feedback session, where you reflect on the experience of doing the project.
sentences.zh: 我想将本次辅导课作为一次反馈环节，让你们反思完成该项目的过程与体验。

sentences.en: So Cristina, I was wondering, what did you enjoy most about making the video?
sentences.zh: 那么，克里斯蒂娜，我想问问你，制作视频过程中你最喜欢的是什么？

sentences.en: CRISTINA: liked using the camera.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 我喜欢使用摄像机。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Is it the first time you've operated one like that?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 这是你第一次操作这类摄像机吗？

sentences.en: CRISTINA: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 是的，确实是第一次。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well the results were very good!
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 哇，成果非常棒！

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: CRISTINA: I also enjoyed visiting one of the British students we filmed.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 我还很喜欢去拜访我们拍摄的一位英国学生。

sentences.en: I'd never been inside a British home before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未进过英国人的家。

sentences.en: TUTOR: OK Cristina, thanks.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 好的，谢谢克里斯蒂娜。

sentences.en: What about you, Ibrahim?
sentences.zh: 那么，易卜拉欣，你呢？

sentences.en: What did you enjoy?
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的是什么？

sentences.en: IBRAHIM: Well for me it was a very good chance to get to know students who are on other courses, because everyone in our group is studying English, and we don't usually have much to do with the rest of the college.
sentences.zh: IBRAHIM: 对我而言，这是一次极好的机会，得以结识其他专业的学生，因为我们小组所有人学的都是英语，平时很少与其他学院同学打交道。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，很好。

sentences.en: Do you think you'll maintain the contact now?
sentences.zh: 你觉得之后会继续保持联系吗？

sentences.en: IBRAHIM: I hope so.
sentences.zh: IBRAHIM: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: I've invited three of them to have dinner with me next week.
sentences.zh: 我已邀请其中三位同学下周来我家共进晚餐。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Great!
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 太棒了！

sentences.en: If you haven't decided what to make yet I can tell you they'll love trying Arab dishes.
sentences.zh: 如果你们还没决定做什么菜，我可以告诉你们，他们一定会很乐意尝试阿拉伯菜肴。

sentences.en: And of course, it's good for your English too.
sentences.zh: 当然，这对提高你的英语也很有帮助。

sentences.en: Cristina, what did you find?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: What was the most useful aspect of the project from the point of view of the English practice?
sentences.zh: 从英语练习的角度来看，这个项目中最有用的部分是什么？

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com

sentences.en: CRISTINA: I think, when we were being shown how to edit the film, we had to follow 7. 3118 the instructions.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 我觉得，在别人教我们如何剪辑影片时，我们必须遵照那些说明进行操作。

sentences.en: And that was very good practice for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说是非常好的练习。

sentences.en: And I also learned Sage.com some technical words that hadn't heard before.
sentences.zh: 而且我还学到了一些之前从未听过的专业术语。

sentences.en: TUTOR: What about you Ibrahim?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那你呢，易卜拉欣？

sentences.en: What was the most useful for your English?
sentences.zh: 对你英语提升最有帮助的是什么？

sentences.en: IBRAHIM: It was listening to the British students, because they don't speak as slowly as most of the tutors on our course. think they speak at natural speed, so it forces me to get used to it.
sentences.zh: IBRAHIM: 是听英国学生的讲话，因为他们说话不像我们课程中的大多数老师那样慢。我觉得他们是以自然语速讲话，因此迫使我逐渐适应这种语速。

sentences.en: And a they use a lot of slang.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还大量使用俚语。

sentences.en: So you learned some new words which will be useful?
sentences.zh: 所以你学到了一些今后会有用的新词汇？

sentences.en: TUTOR:
sentences.zh: TUTOR:

sentences.en: IBRAHIM: Yes.
sentences.zh: IBRAHIM: 是的。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好。

sentences.en: I'm glad it helped.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴这确实帮到了你。

sentences.en: Well, we've talked a little bit about enjoyment, and about language practice.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们已经简单聊了聊参与过程中的乐趣以及语言练习方面的收获。

sentences.en: Were there any other benefits?
sentences.zh: 还有其他益处吗？

sentences.en: What else did you feel you'd learnt from the project?
sentences.zh: 除此之外，你还觉得从这个项目中学到了什么？

sentences.en: Was it useful in other ways?
sentences.zh: 它在其他方面也有用吗？

sentences.en: CRISTINA: Yes, well firstly, I learned how to use a video camera.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 是的，首先，我学会了如何使用摄像机。

sentences.en: And also, I think I really learned a lot about working together with other people.
sentences.zh: 此外，我觉得自己确实在与他人合作方面学到了很多。

sentences.en: I've never done anything with a group before, and we had to find ways of cooperating, erm, and compromising, and sometimes persuading people, when they don't agree with you.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未参与过任何小组活动，而这次我们必须找到合作的方法，呃，还要学会妥协，有时甚至需要说服那些不同意你观点的人。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Yes, that is a very useful experience, I know.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 是的，我知道这确实是一次非常宝贵的经历。

sentences.en: TUTOR: What about you, Ibrahim?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 那么你呢，易卜拉欣？

sentences.en: IBRAHIM: Well, I think I learnt a lot about how important editing is.
sentences.zh: IBRAHIM: 嗯，我觉得自己深刻认识到剪辑有多么重要。

sentences.en: When you're filming 027 you think that everything's going to be interesting, but in fact we cut around half of it in the end, and then it was much better.
sentences.zh: 拍摄时，你总以为所有内容都会很有趣，但实际上我们最终删减了大约一半的素材，成片效果反而好得多。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Good.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 很好。

sentences.en: Well, one last thing I'd like to ask.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最后我还想问一个问题。

sentences.en: What mistakes do you think you, as a group that is, made?
sentences.zh: 你们作为小组，认为自己犯了哪些错误？

sentences.en: I mean, to put it another way, if you had to do it all it over again, is there anything you'd do differently?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果让你们重新来一遍，有什么地方会做得不一样？

sentences.en: CRISTINA: We didn't plan very well.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 我们前期计划得不够充分。

sentences.en: For example, we didn't decide on dates when we'd complete each separate step of the project, and we should have agreed about that in the beginning, because we were always late with everything!
sentences.zh: 例如，我们没有事先确定完成项目各个阶段的具体日期；本应在一开始便就此达成一致，结果我们每件事都严重拖延！

sentences.en: TUTOR: Right.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 明白了。

sentences.en: Anything else?
sentences.zh: 还有别的吗？

sentences.en: CRISTINA: think we should have tried to experiment more with the camera.
sentences.zh: CRISTINA: 我觉得我们本该更多地尝试摄像机的各种功能。

sentences.en: I mean with angles, and the focus and that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 比如不同拍摄角度、对焦方式等这类技术。

sentences.en: TUTOR: So you should have been more ambitious?
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 所以你们本该更有雄心一些？

sentences.en: Do you agree, Ibrahim?
sentences.zh: 易卜拉欣，你同意吗？

sentences.en: IBRAHIM: Not really.
sentences.zh: IBRAHIM: 并不完全同意。

sentences.en: In fact, I think we were too ambitious.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我觉得我们当时野心太大了。

sentences.en: We were inexperienced, and we didn't have a lot of time, and we tried to do too much, to make a long film.
sentences.zh: 我们缺乏经验，时间又很紧张，却试图完成太多内容，非要拍一部很长的影片。

sentences.en: Next time would make a shorter one and try to get the quality better.
sentences.zh: 下次我们会先拍一部较短的影片，并努力提升整体质量。

sentences.en: TUTOR: Well, that's very interesting.
sentences.zh: TUTOR: 嗯，这非常有意思。

sentences.en: Next semester we will be doing another video project - with a different content, of course but you'll have an opportunity to put into practice what you've learnt this time.
sentences.zh: 下学期我们将开展另一项视频制作项目——当然主题会有所不同，但你们将有机会把本次学到的经验付诸实践。

sentences.en: Do you have any ideas about ..
sentences.zh: 你们对……有什么想法吗？

sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿
